currentParagraphText: “Chieftain say want!” one of the Simivitas yelled, having seemingly learned some words. The others turned to it and hollered a bit angrily at giving out information like that... but Keerla was very grateful as she didn’t hesitate to activate the emergency signal of the Hunting Grounds manual.
